name: RudderStack Cloud Free
free_limit: Free-forever hosted customer event pipeline with 250,000 events/month, 16 SDK sources, 200+ cloud destinations and up to 10 team members.
watch_out: New accounts initially receive a 30-day Growth trial and must choose Free afterward. Free plan has fewer transformations and 3-hour warehouse syncs; data processing can stop after repeated monthly overages. Warehouse/destination provider charges are separate; do not confuse this managed Free plan with Elastic-2.0 self-hosted software.
